worldcombat.ai.tackle.maxChase.help: Wait for distant targets to approach; an explicit focus order takes priority.
worldcombat.ai.tackle.leaveStation.help: Autonomous Tackle only; otherwise intercept within reach of the station.
worldcombat.ai.growth.targetLight.help: Limited by the current storage capacity.
worldcombat.ai.growth.minSafeTicks.help: Quiet time before gathering automatically; 20 ticks equal one second.
worldcombat.ai.solarbeam.waitForClear.he: Wait without spending resources when the beam is blocked.
worldcombat.ai.sleeppowder.avoidSleeping: Avoid wasting powder on targets already asleep.
worldcombat.ai.sleeppowder.leadTarget.he: Cover the recently observed path ahead; stationary targets are aimed at directly.
worldcombat.ai.sweetscent.search.help: Choose what automatic searching looks for.
worldcombat.ai.sweetscent.autoSearch.hel: Search suitable subjects autonomously; this still spends the move’s PP.
worldcombat.ai.substitute.useBelow.help: Autonomous use threshold; enough health must remain after payment.
Check expected payment; actual payment follows the damage pipeline.
worldcombat.ai.substitute.placement.help: Place toward danger or toward the trainer.
worldcombat.ai.venoshock.cashIn.help: Only affects autonomous choices when poison consumption is enabled.
worldcombat.ai.venoshock.finishHealth.he: When waiting, cash in below this target health fraction.
worldcombat.ai.synthesis.healBelow.help: Preserve PP above this health fraction.
worldcombat.ai.helpinghand.prefer.help: Prioritize allies in combat or injured allies.
worldcombat.ai.ingrain.useBelow.help: Root at a rest location only below this health fraction.
worldcombat.ai.gigadrain.healBelow.help: Prioritize draining below this fraction; manual attacks remain available.
